meta.name: deposit-attrition
meta.description: Members whose deposit balances are draining, ranked by the money that has already left — the retention call list, plus where the losses cluster by segment and branch.

lookback_months.description: Window over which to measure the balance decline.

decline_threshold_pct.description: Flag a member when their deposit balance has fallen by this percentage or more over the window.

min_starting_balance.description: Ignore members who started below this balance — percentage falls on tiny balances are noise that buries the real departures.
